opportunities.title: Research Fund

amount.raw: up to £5000 of funding for 12 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC, or Fellow FRSC) holding an independent research post; not currently holding another active Research Fund grant; limited to one per department with Head of Department support.
opportunities.summary: Supports members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Covers chemicals/equipment, consumables, software licences, equipment repairs and equipment access.

opportunities.title: Researcher Development and Travel Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Partner Scientist, Associate Member, Member or Fellow) who are PhD students or researchers in chemical sciences within 10 years of leaving full-time education; one grant per three calendar years.
opportunities.summary: Supports PhD students and early career scientists to undertake activities supporting their research career, such as presenting at conferences, attending training courses or organising scientific meetings.

opportunities.title: Grants for Carers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Chemists based in the UK or Ireland, or RSC members for at least three consecutive years if based outside; must incur additional caring expenses while attending a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event; must have an active role in the event.
opportunities.summary: Supports carers to attend chemistry-related meetings, conferences, workshops or professional development events by covering additional care costs they incur, e.g. home help, nursing care, respite care or travel expenses for a relative to accompany them.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund

amount.raw: Grant amounts not specified on page

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants aged 18 and over, UK or Republic of Ireland residents (with UK/ROI address and bank account) or applying on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK/ROI; project must have a significant aspect related to chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Funds chemistry-based public engagement and outreach activities that connect communities with the chemical sciences, develop chemists' engagement skills, engage school students and public audiences, and provide underrepresented audiences with chemistry engagement opportunities.

opportunities.title: Accessibility Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Chemists based in the UK or Ireland, or RSC members for at least three consecutive years if based outside; must use funds to cover support/assistance personally required due to a disability, impairment or health condition to attend a chemistry-related event; must have an active role in the event.
opportunities.summary: Supports chemists with disabilities and ongoing health conditions to attend chemistry-related meetings, conferences, workshops or professional development events by covering costs of equipment, services or personal expenses associated with meeting their access needs.

opportunities.title: Researcher Collaborations Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC, or Fellow FRSC); PhD students or researchers at any career stage, in any sector or location.
opportunities.summary: Enables researchers to establish and develop collaborations and networks beyond their own institution, including national, international, interdisciplinary and cross-sector collaborations, through research visits to collaborators' institutions and organising meetings/workshops.
